QuestInfo.name: Instrumental
QuestInfo.0: Listen to what June has to say about Blake. It's pretty interesting.
QuestInfo.1: June says that Blake's been weird lately. He says that Blake feels like a completely different person...he can't remember things from the past, puts up a polite facade around June, and just acts strange in general. June thinks that it all started after Blake bought a guitar. Ask Blake about that guitar.
QuestInfo.2: Blake seems surprised that you asked about the guitar. He's clearly hiding something.
